THE PEOPLE & PURPOSE BEHIND THE MOSAIC

Technology, with
humanity at its heart.

Humanitarian Tracker connects citizen knowledge with technology, crowdsourcing and AI for social good.

Community is
where it begins.

Humanitarian Tracker’s original website describes a volunteer-powered, non-political, non-partisan organization with no religious affiliation. Its work spans humanitarian reporting, health, education and development.

Global Action Mosaic carries that experience into a platform for community-led initiatives advancing the Sustainable Development Goals.

Read the original mission ↗

Listen.

Local contributors share experiences and knowledge through text, photographs and video.

Corroborate.

The original methodology describes checking reports against other citizen contributions and official sources.

Connect.

Mapping and analysis bring individual contributions into a picture that others can explore.

Care for the people
behind the data.

Identity protection, responsible reporting and acknowledging data limitations are central themes in Humanitarian Tracker’s original work. Historical methods should be read in their original context.
